prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished full-screen landscape 16:9 art proposal for the WAITING ROOM screen of the Brazilian casual board game Império Urbano. Use the supplied project menu screenshot as a visual style reference: premium illustrated Brazilian tropical beach, bright turquoise ocean, palms, golden wooden deck, deep navy/royal blue translucent panels, elegant gold beveled outlines, bold clean highly readable Portuguese typography. This is a new waiting-room layout, not the play/create screen. Maintain artistic continuity, no copied competitor UI. Background beach visible around the interface, tasteful small hibiscus/coconut details at extreme edges. The screen must feel spacious and inviting, practical for landscape mobile adaptation. Main panel fills most of the viewport with soft rounded corners and thin luminous gold edge. Header top-left: small crown emblem and title 'Sala de espera'; small subtitle 'Reúna a turma. A partida já vai começar!'. Top-right inside header a compact pill 'Modo Clássico', and separate navy/gold button 'Sair da sala'. A centered invitation strip under header: label 'CÓDIGO DA SALA', large readable 'BR7K2P', modest 'Copiar código' button with copy icon. Main content two columns: left about 68% wide, right about 30%. Left section heading 'Jogadores · 3/4'. Four equal beautifully designed vertical player cards in a single row, matching the project's original expressive cartoon portrait art. Card 1: youthful cheerful dark-haired male portrait, tiny gold crown marking host, nickname 'Vinícius', secondary '(você)', green check badge 'Pronto'. Card 2: cheerful brown-skinned woman with curly dark hair, nickname 'Marina', green check 'Pronto'. Card 3: friendly young man in green shirt, nickname 'Lucas', amber badge 'Escolhendo'. Card 4: elegant subdued dashed outline empty slot, simple person-plus icon, text 'Vaga livre', secondary 'Aguardando jogador'. Portraits in circular frames with purple/blue/green player accents, NO giant full-body characters, no experience or economy stats. Right column a coordinated smaller panel titled 'Seu personagem', selected original cartoon male character in blue outfit as a polished little stylized 3D game pawn on a subtle circular pedestal, a row of five small round avatar portrait selectors beneath, and a row of five colored circular swatches under label 'Cor do peão'. Footer within main panel: left small info 'O anfitrião inicia quando todos estiverem prontos.'; central outlined button 'Não estou pronto'; right larger muted blue disabled-looking button with small lock icon 'Iniciar partida', with small caption 'Aguardando todos ficarem prontos'. Balanced hierarchy: invitation and players are the focus, gold accents restrained, sufficient breathing room, no clutter. All Portuguese texts spelled correctly, readable and aligned, no extraneous text, no coin/diamond shop, no AI options, no chat feature, no board, no watermark. Present a finished attractive interface concept with exact typography and intentional layout, not a collage or asset sheet.
